lines.text: In Jehoiakim's fourth year, the LORD told Jeremiah to write his words on a scroll, and Baruch wrote them.
In the ninth month of the fifth year, Baruch read the scroll to the people from Gemariah's chamber.
Jehudi read the scroll to the king in his winter quarters, and Jehoiakim burned it despite Elnathan, Delaiah and Gemariah.
